target_customer: Argentine retail users protecting savings in dollars through stablecoins, plus businesses using the exchange and payment API
problem: Argentines facing inflation and currency controls needed a simple way to hold dollars; buying dollars legally was restricted.
business_model: Exchange spread and fees on ARS to USD and crypto trades, plus a payment API gateway for merchants
product_category: Crypto exchange and dollar access app

founders.name: Federico Goldberg
founders.background_notes: Built a smart contract World Cup game in 2018 and Tienda Dolar (YC page).

founders.name: Nicolas D'Onofrio
founders.background_notes: Describes himself as a tech founder on the YC page.

founders.name: Ramiro Furtado
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

founders.name: Martin Nagelberg
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

competitors.name: Buenbit
competitors.what: Argentine crypto exchange offering a dollar stablecoin route around currency controls
competitors.traction_then: described as a working legal workaround in July 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Exchange with bank rails, KYC and liquidity for ARS to USD conversion, plus crypto custody; mostly operational and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Several Argentine exchanges offered the same dollar crypto route, and the spread business is easy to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rival exchanges and later Lemon Cash competed on the same product; no acquisition of Tienda was found.

market_need_then: Argentina had a currency control regime and high inflation, driving demand for dollar savings; later articles describe a digital dollar rising in popularity.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and simple, tagline the simplest crypto exchange

branding.community_and_virality: Publishes a finance newsletter on Substack.

brand_strength.rationale: Spanish word for shop in a descriptive name; two parallel brands, Tienda Dolar and Tienda Crypto, with no brand press beyond launch coverage.

pivots.from: Tienda Dolar, a digital ARS to USD exchange
pivots.to: Tienda Crypto, a broader exchange and payment API gateway
pivots.why: Added crypto exchange and merchant payments; Descubre.vc reported the start of Tienda Crypto operations in January 2022.

outcome_analysis: Tienda Crypto grew from Tienda Dolar, a retail ARS to USD service reported at about 6 million dollars of monthly volume, into a CNV registered crypto exchange and payment gateway in Buenos Aires with about 37 staff. No funding amount, exit or distress is public, and several local rivals offered similar products, so there is no sourced explanation of its relative success.
notes: Funding searches (English and Spanish) found no rounds; aggregators list seed stage with no amount. The Buenbit source was seen only in search results, not opened; its funding then is null. Coindesk Buenbit article returned 404. Ripio and Satoshi Tango are cited only by undated pages so they are not listed. The website says SIXALIME S.A.S. is a CNV registered virtual asset provider and that registration is not a license.
